ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud schemes, including the use of shell companies and money laundering.
questions: How are individuals using shell companies to launder money in Medicaid fraud schemes?
What are the most common tactics used to defraud the Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: The use of shell companies and money laundering is a critical aspect of Medicaid fraud schemes. By following the money, we can identify the individuals and companies involved in these schemes and determine the full extent of their involvement.
